readme_excerpt: DSPy: Programming—not prompting—Foundation Models Documentation: DSPy Docs DSPy is the framework for programming—rather than prompting—language models. It allows you to iterate fast on building modular AI systems and offers algorithms for optimizing their prompts and weights, whether you're building simple classifiers, sophisticated RAG pipelines, or Agent loops.
